scripts.build:staging: tsc --noEmit && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging vite build && node scripts/remove-build-secrets.mjs
scripts.build:production: tsc --noEmit && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production vite build && node scripts/remove-build-secrets.mjs
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:production && wrangler deploy --env production --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply character-taste-lab-v2-clean-local --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply character-taste-lab-v2-staging --remote --env staging --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply character-taste-lab --remote --env production --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.contracts: npm run contracts:ddl && npm run contracts:schemas
